# 1  Shared helpers

```{r helpers}
# Safe left_join: warns if RHS has duplicate keys
safe_left_join <- function(x, y, by) {
  dups <- y %>% count(across(all_of(by))) %>% filter(n > 1)
  if (nrow(dups) > 0)
    message("WARNING: duplicate RHS keys for join on: ", paste(by, collapse = ", "))
  left_join(x, y, by = by)
}

# Safe division (returns NA instead of Inf / NaN)
safe_div <- function(num, den) {
  ifelse(is.finite(num) & is.finite(den) & den != 0, num / den, NA_real_)
}

# Shared ggplot theme used throughout
theme_lcc <- function(...) {
  theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 12),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, vjust = 2),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 12),
      strip.text   = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      ...
    )
}

# StudyArea display order
STUDY_AREA_LEVELS <- c("AK tundra", "AK boreal", "AK maritime",
                       "Yukon", "NWT", "Quebec", "NL", "Sweden")
```

# 2  Build atmosphere / bomb-curve reference

```{r atmosphere}
bomb_curve <- as.data.frame(Hua2021$NHZone2[, 1:2]) %>%
  rename(year = Year, D14C = mean.Delta14C) %>%
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year))

d14c_extra <- read_csv("D14C_age_new.csv",
                       show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year))

f_subset <- bind_rows(d14c_extra, bomb_curve) %>%
  filter(!is.na(year)) %>%
  group_by(year_floor = floor(year)) %>%
  slice_min(abs(year - year_floor), with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(year = year_floor, D14C)

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(f_subset$year))

f_subset_x14c <- rename(f_subset, X14C = D14C)
```

# 3  Site data

## 3.1  Alaska / Walker plots

```{r site-alaska}
aa <- read_csv("PLOT_03172025_final.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

alaska_raw <- aa %>%
  mutate(
    StdAge = as.integer(round(StdAge, 0)),
    year2  = recent_burn - StdAge,
    year   = if_else(year2 > 1900, year2, round(year2 / 5) * 5)
  )

site_alaska <- alaska_raw %>%
  select(fire, site, plot, year,
         latitude, longitude, elevation, slope, aspect, moisture_class,
         recent_burn, reburn_class_7, ForestType,
         burn_depth, residualSOL_depth, StdAge,
         residualSOL.C, SOL.C.Combusted, prefireSOL.C) %>%
  safe_left_join(f_subset, by = "year") %>%
  rename(
    stand_age14C   = D14C,
    stand_age      = StdAge,
    Moisture_Class = moisture_class,
    Elevation      = elevation,
    Slope          = slope,
    Aspect         = aspect,
    Year_of_Burn   = recent_burn,
    Latitude       = latitude,
    Longitude      = longitude
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    StudyArea          = "Alaska",
    Researcher         = "Walker",
    siteplot           = paste(site, plot, sep = "_"),
    project            = "LC",
    reburn_class_final = reburn_class_7
  )
site_alaska <- site_alaska %>%
  mutate(site = as.character(site))
```

## 3.2  LCC + NWT sites

```{r site-lcc-nwt}
coerce_site_numerics <- function(df) {
  df %>% mutate(across(
    c(Aspect, Year_of_Burn, Stand_age, Latitude, Longitude, Elevation, Slope),
    ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.))
  ))
}

LCC <- read_csv("LCC_Site_Data_PLEASE CHECK_08_26_2025.csv",
                show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(project = "LCC") %>%
  coerce_site_numerics()

NWT <- read_csv("NWT_Site_Data_Walker.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    project = "NWT",
    Coordinate_Reference_System..projection.or.EPSG. = NA_character_,
    Sampling_Date = as.character(Sampling_Date)
  ) %>%
  coerce_site_numerics()

LCC_combined <- bind_rows(LCC, NWT) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ na_if(., ""))) %>%
  rename(ForestType = Dom_Tree) %>%
  mutate(
    Stand_age    = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Stand_age)),
    Year_of_Burn = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Year_of_Burn)),
    stand_age_imputed = case_when(
      is.na(Stand_age) & StudyArea == "AK tundra" ~ "imputed_250",
      is.na(Stand_age)                             ~ "imputed_100",
      TRUE                                         ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Stand_age_new = case_when(
      is.na(Stand_age) & StudyArea == "AK tundra" ~ 250,
      is.na(Stand_age)                             ~ 100,
      TRUE                                         ~ Stand_age
    )
  )

EXCLUDE_SITES <- c(
  "SM 31-2 Unburned", "NP 19-2 Unburned",
  "WF-LCC-1", "WF-LCC-2", "WF-LCC-3", "WF-LCC-4",
  "SM 44-2 Unburned"
)

LCC_combined <- LCC_combined %>%
  mutate(
    year_raw = if_else(
      !(site %in% EXCLUDE_SITES),
      Year_of_Burn - Stand_age_new,
      Year_of_Burn
    ),
    year = if_else(year_raw < 1901, round(year_raw / 5) * 5, year_raw)
  )

site_lcc <- LCC_combined %>%
  safe_left_join(f_subset, by = "year") %>%
  rename(
    stand_age14C      = D14C,
    stand_age         = Stand_age_new,
    siteplot          = site,
    burn_depth        = Burn_Depth,
    residualSOL_depth = SOL_depth
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    fire            = NA_character_,
    site            = NA_character_,
    plot            = NA_character_,
    residualSOL.C   = NA_real_,
    SOL.C.Combusted = NA_real_,
    prefireSOL.C    = NA_real_,
    across(c(Latitude, Longitude, Elevation, Slope, Aspect,
             residualSOL_depth, burn_depth),
           ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.)))
  )
```

## 3.3  Merge all sites

```{r site-merge}
CHAR_COLS <- c("site", "plot", "fire", "Researcher", "StudyArea", "project",
               "reburn_class_final", "Moisture_Class", "ForestType", "siteplot")

all.site <- bind_rows(
  site_lcc   %>% mutate(across(all_of(intersect(names(.), CHAR_COLS)), as.character)),
  site_alaska %>% mutate(across(all_of(intersect(names(.), CHAR_COLS)), as.character))
) %>%
  mutate(
    Researcher = if_else(Researcher == "Walker" & StudyArea == "NWT",
                         "Walker/Mack", Researcher),
    fire = if_else(
      Researcher == "Walker/Mack",
      str_extract(siteplot, "^[^-]+"),
      fire
    )
  )

all.site2 <- all.site %>%
  mutate(
    Researcher = case_when(
      str_detect(Researcher, "Dominique Arseneault") ~ "Arseneault",
      str_detect(Researcher, "Lucas Brehaut")        ~ "Brehaut",
      str_detect(Researcher, "Gundale/Nilsson")       ~ "Gundale",
      str_detect(Researcher, "Kirsten Reid")          ~ "Brown",
      str_detect(Researcher, "Hung") | str_detect(Researcher, "Natali") ~ "Hung-Natali",
      TRUE ~ Researcher
    ),
    StudyArea = if_else(StudyArea %in% c("Western Quebec", "Eastern Quebec"),
                        "Quebec", StudyArea),
    # ── Canonical moisture class names (submesic replaces mesic-subxeric) ───────
    Moisture_Class = case_when(
      Moisture_Class %in% c("Subhydric", "Subhydric ", "6") ~ "subhygric",
      Moisture_Class %in% c("1", "Xeric")                   ~ "xeric",
      Moisture_Class == "2"                                  ~ "subxeric",
      Moisture_Class == "3"                                  ~ "submesic",
      Moisture_Class == "4"                                  ~ "mesic",
      Moisture_Class == "5"                                  ~ "mesic-subhygric",
      TRUE ~ Moisture_Class
    ),
    site = if_else(is.na(site) & !is.na(siteplot), siteplot, site)
  )

write_csv(all.site2, "LCC_allsites_05162026.csv")
```

# 4  Radiocarbon data

## 4.1  Load & clean long-format radiocarbon file

```{r rc-load}
radio <- read_csv("LCC_14C_long_clean_08262025.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename(
    new.depth    = `new depth`,
    new.X14C     = `new X14C`,
    new.X14C.err = `new X14C.err`,
    new.F14C     = `new F14C`,
    new.F14C.err = `new F14C.err`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    depth      = coalesce(`new.depth`,    depth),
    X14C       = coalesce(`new.X14C`,     X14C),
    X14C.err   = coalesce(`new.X14C.err`, X14C.err),
    F14C       = coalesce(`new.F14C`,     F14C),
    F14C.err   = coalesce(`new.F14C.err`, F14C.err)
  ) %>%
  select(-starts_with("new.")) %>%
  mutate(
    Researcher = if_else(Researcher == "Pare", "Pare-Laganiere", Researcher),
    across(c(site, plot, siteplot), as.character)
  )

# Sample relabels: measured values moved to a different position in the core
# where they are out of depth order in a way consistent with a labelling
# mix-up. NOT verified against lab or field records. Affected profiles are
# flagged (samples_relabeled = TRUE in the archive) so they can be excluded
# or tested in sensitivity analysis. The original label stays in `section`.
SAMPLE_RELABELS <- tribble(
  ~ID,       ~new_section, ~new_depth, ~relabel_reason,
  # MID <-> BOTTOM
  "LCC_170", "BOTTOM",      9,  "MID/BOTTOM swap (unverified)",   # Lab-03
  "LCC_171", "MID",         2,  "MID/BOTTOM swap (unverified)",
  "LCC_280", "BOTTOM",     28,  "MID/BOTTOM swap (unverified)",   # TUN10 23AP40B1
  "LCC_281", "MID",         2,  "MID/BOTTOM swap (unverified)",
  "LC_222",  "BOTTOM",      3,  "MID/BOTTOM swap (unverified)",   # LC_188C
  "LC_223",  "MID",         2,  "MID/BOTTOM swap (unverified)",
  "RC138",   "BOTTOM",      3,  "MID/BOTTOM swap (unverified)",   # ZF20-10A_12
  "RC139",   "MID",         2,  "MID/BOTTOM swap (unverified)",
  # TOP <-> BOTTOM (core reversed)
  "LCC_233", "BOTTOM",     20,  "TOP/BOTTOM swap (unverified)",   # Sample 5
  "LCC_235", "TOP",         1,  "TOP/BOTTOM swap (unverified)"
  # LCC-10-JB and Jl-02-1 are NOT swapped: their only inversion involves MID,
  # which is tolerated (6.4), and swapping would replace their measured old
  # surface carbon with a bomb-carbon sample.
)

stopifnot(all(SAMPLE_RELABELS$ID %in% radio$ID))

radio <- radio %>%
  left_join(SAMPLE_RELABELS, by = "ID") %>%
  mutate(
    Section_new = coalesce(new_section, Section_new),
    depth       = coalesce(new_depth, depth)
  ) %>%
  select(-new_section, -new_depth, -relabel_reason)

RELABELED_CORES <- radio %>% filter(ID %in% SAMPLE_RELABELS$ID) %>% distinct(soilID) %>% pull(soilID)
cat("Profiles with relabelled samples:", length(RELABELED_CORES), "\n")
```

## 4.2  Join site metadata to radiocarbon data

```{r rc-site-join}
SKIP_PLOT <- c("Hung-Natali", "Baltzer", "Diaz-Veraverbeke")

KEYS_FULL    <- c("project","StudyArea","Researcher","fire","site","plot","siteplot")
KEYS_NO_PLOT <- c("project","StudyArea","Researcher","fire","site","siteplot")

site_non_nwt  <- all.site2 %>% filter(tolower(project) != "nwt")
radio_non_nwt <- radio     %>% filter(tolower(project) != "nwt")

join_with_plot <- radio_non_nwt %>%
  filter(!Researcher %in% SKIP_PLOT) %>%
  left_join(
    site_non_nwt %>%
      filter(!Researcher %in% SKIP_PLOT) %>%
      distinct(across(all_of(KEYS_FULL)), .keep_all = TRUE),
    by = KEYS_FULL, relationship = "many-to-one"
  )

join_no_plot <- radio_non_nwt %>%
  filter(Researcher %in% SKIP_PLOT) %>%
  left_join(
    site_non_nwt %>%
      filter(Researcher %in% SKIP_PLOT) %>%
      distinct(across(all_of(KEYS_NO_PLOT)), .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
      select(-plot),
    by = KEYS_NO_PLOT, relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  { if ("plot.x" %in% names(.)) rename(., plot = plot.x) else . }

non_nwt_join <- bind_rows(join_with_plot, join_no_plot)

NWT_KEYS <- c("project","StudyArea","Researcher","fire","site")

nwt_join <- radio %>%
  filter(tolower(project) == "nwt") %>%
  left_join(
    all.site2 %>%
      filter(tolower(project) == "nwt") %>%
      distinct(across(all_of(NWT_KEYS)), .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
      select(-plot),
    by = NWT_KEYS, relationship = "many-to-one"
  )

drop_anon_cols <- function(df) select(df, -matches("^\\.\\.\\.\\d+$"))

all_joined <- bind_rows(
  drop_anon_cols(non_nwt_join),
  drop_anon_cols(nwt_join)
)

SITE_CLEAN_COLS <- c(
  "project", "StudyArea", "Researcher", "fire", "site", "plot", "siteplot",
  "Year_of_Burn", "year", "stand_age", "stand_age_imputed", "stand_age14C",
  "Stand_age_SD", "Stand_age_number",
  "Latitude", "Longitude", "Elevation", "Slope", "Aspect",
  "Moisture_Class", "ForestType", "Eco_Type", "reburn_class_final",
  "Dom_Understory", "Dom_ground",
  "burn_depth", "residualSOL_depth", "residualSOL.C", "SOL.C.Combusted", "prefireSOL.C",
  "SOL_depth_SD", "SOL_depth_number",
  "Burn_depth_SD", "Burn_depth_number",
  "Thaw_depth", "Thaw_depth_SD", "Thaw_depth_number",
  "Burn_depth_method", "age_method", "area_sampled", "area_sampled_trees",
  "tree1_species", "tree1_density", "tree1_density_SD",
  "tree1_basalarea", "tree1_basalarea_SD",
  "tree2_species", "tree2_density", "tree2_density_SD",
  "tree2_basalarea", "tree2_basalarea_SD",
  "tree3_species", "tree3_density", "tree3_basalarea",
  "Coordinate_Reference_System..projection.or.EPSG."
)

site_clean <- all_joined %>%
  select(any_of(SITE_CLEAN_COLS)) %>%
  distinct(project, StudyArea, Researcher, fire, site, plot, siteplot, .keep_all = TRUE)
write_csv(site_clean, "LCC_Site_clean_05162026.csv")

sr1 <- all_joined %>%
  select(ID, project, Researcher:siteplot, soilID:rerolled)
write_csv(sr1, "LCC_14C_long_clean_05162026.csv")
```

# 5  Build the site-level input file

One row per soil profile (soilID), holding every site-level value the pipeline
uses: site metadata from section 3 (via the radiocarbon join in 4.2), spatial
climate data, Walker/Mack measured SOL C pools, and the new field-measured SOL C
combustion estimates. It contains no radiocarbon, CN, or derived values.

```{r build-site-input}
SITE_KEYS <- c("project","StudyArea","Researcher","fire","site","plot","siteplot")

# Each soilID must sit in exactly one fire/site/plot combination
key_check <- all_joined %>%
  distinct(soilID, across(all_of(SITE_KEYS))) %>%
  count(soilID) %>%
  filter(n > 1)
if (nrow(key_check) > 0) {
  print(key_check)
  stop("Some soilIDs map to more than one fire/site/plot combination")
}


# Profile-level site data
site_input <- all_joined %>%
  select(soilID, any_of(SITE_CLEAN_COLS)) %>%
  distinct(soilID, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Spatial data: Walker sites join on site + fire, others on site only
sp_nonwalker <- read_csv("2025-12-02_LCC_SpatialData.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(site = as.character(site)) %>%
  select(site, MAT, MAP, tree_cover) %>%
  distinct(site, .keep_all = TRUE)

sp_walker <- read_csv("2025-11-26_LC_site_SpatialData.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(site = as.character(site), fire = as.character(fire)) %>%
  select(site, fire, MAT, MAP, tree_cover) %>%
  distinct(site, fire, .keep_all = TRUE)

site_input <- site_input %>%
  mutate(.site = as.character(site), .fire = as.character(fire)) %>%
  left_join(sp_walker %>%
              rename(.site = site, .fire = fire,
                     MAT_w = MAT, MAP_w = MAP, tc_w = tree_cover),
            by = c(".site", ".fire")) %>%
  left_join(sp_nonwalker %>%
              rename(.site = site, MAT_nw = MAT, MAP_nw = MAP, tc_nw = tree_cover),
            by = ".site") %>%
  mutate(
    MAT        = coalesce(MAT_w, MAT_nw),
    MAP        = coalesce(MAP_w, MAP_nw),
    tree_cover = coalesce(tc_w,  tc_nw)
  ) %>%
  select(-.site, -.fire, -MAT_w, -MAP_w, -tc_w, -MAT_nw, -MAP_nw, -tc_nw)


PARISIEN_SAMPLE_YEAR <- 2021   # Parisien profiles were all sampled in 2021

site_input <- site_input %>%
  mutate(
    # Parisien profiles from unburned stands, or from fires > 20 yr before
    # sampling, are archived but not used in the manuscript
    archive_only = Researcher == "Parisien" &
      (is.na(Year_of_Burn) |
         PARISIEN_SAMPLE_YEAR - suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Year_of_Burn)) > 20),
    archive_only_reason = if_else(
      archive_only,
      "Parisien: unburned or fire > 20 yr before sampling (2021)",
      NA_character_),

    # Ecosystem class for profiles the 8-level Eco rules cannot classify.
    # NP 11-1: white spruce upland (Picea glauca) in NWT. In NWT, "Other
    # conifer" has no Upland/Lowland rule, so Eco would otherwise be NA.
    Eco_override = case_when(
      soilID == "NP 11-1 Burned" ~ "Western NA Upland Spruce",
      TRUE                       ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# Check: expect 8 archive-only profiles (NP 11-1 Burned and NP 19-1 Burned are used)
site_input %>% filter(Researcher == "Parisien") %>%
  select(soilID, Year_of_Burn, archive_only, Eco_override)



# Walker/Mack measured SOL pools (joined on site, as in the original pipeline)
mw_sol <- read_csv("NWT_walker_SOL_C.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  select(site,
         SOL.C.Combusted_WM = SOL.C.Combusted,
         prefireSOL.C_WM    = prefire.SOL.C,
         residualSOL.C_WM   = residualSOL.C)

site_input <- site_input %>%
  left_join(mw_sol, by = "site", relationship = "many-to-one")

# New field-measured SOL C combustion (Diaz-Veraverbeke, Gundale, Metcalfe)
new_comb <- read_csv("LCC_newSOLcombustion.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  group_by(soilID) %>%
  summarise(SOL.C.Combusted_profile = mean(SOL.C.Combusted, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

site_input <- site_input %>%
  left_join(new_comb, by = "soilID", relationship = "one-to-one")

# Site classifications (formerly pipeline sections 6.8, 6.11 and 6.13).
# StudyArea stays as in the source files because it is a join key; the
# canonical names ("AK boreal", "AK maritime") are used here only to apply the
# rules, and are set in the pipeline (6.7).
site_input <- site_input %>%
  mutate(
    .sa = case_when(
      StudyArea == "Alaska" ~ "AK boreal",
      StudyArea == "Kenai"  ~ "AK maritime",
      TRUE ~ StudyArea
    ),
    ft  = str_squish(str_to_lower(ForestType)),
    eco = str_squish(str_to_lower(Eco_Type)),

    ForestGroup = case_when(
      # ── Siteplot-specific overrides ──────────────────────────────────────────
      siteplot == "36_1" ~ "Deciduous/Mixed",       # post-fire aspen on BS site; Hayes
      siteplot == "21_C" ~ "Black spruce",           # MIXED code but confirmed BS

      # ── Walker rules ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      Researcher == "Walker" &
        str_detect(tolower(ForestType), "non.forested|non-forested") ~ "Black spruce",
      Researcher == "Walker/Mack"                                    ~ "Black spruce",
      Researcher == "Walker" & .sa == "AK boreal" &
        (is.na(ft) | ft == "")                                       ~ "Black spruce",

      # ── From Eco_Type ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      str_detect(eco, "black spruce")                                ~ "Black spruce",

      # ── From ForestType (explicit wins) ──────────────────────────────────────
      !is.na(ft) & ft != "" &
        str_detect(ft, "picea mariana|\\bpima\\b|black spruce")      ~ "Black spruce",
      !is.na(ft) & ft != "" &
        str_detect(ft, paste0("populus tremuloides|\\bpotr\\b|aspen|",
                              "betula neoalaskana|paper birch|birch|\\bbene\\b|\\bmixed\\b")) ~ "Deciduous/Mixed",
      !is.na(ft) & ft != "" &
        str_detect(ft, paste0("pinus banksiana|pinus sylvestris|jack pine|scots pine|",
                              "picea glauca|\\bpigl\\b|white spruce|",
                              "picea abies|norwegian spruce|abies balsamea|balsam fir")) ~ "Other conifer",
      !is.na(ft) &
        str_detect(ft, paste0("non[. -]?forested|tundra|peatland|eriophorum|",
                              "low deciduous shrub|betula nana|salix|",
                              "empetrum nigrum|rhododendron subarcticum|vaccinium")) ~ "Tundra / Non-forested",

      # ── Eco_Type fallbacks ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      (is.na(ft) | ft == "") &
        str_detect(eco, "tundra|peatland|non[. -]?forested")         ~ "Tundra / Non-forested",
      (is.na(ft) | ft == "") &
        str_detect(eco, "white spruce|norwegian spruce|spruce upland|scots pine|young pine|jack pine") ~ "Other conifer",
      (is.na(ft) | ft == "") &
        str_detect(eco, "aspen|birch|mixed")                         ~ "Deciduous/Mixed",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    ForestGroup = factor(ForestGroup,
                         levels = c("Black spruce", "Other conifer",
                                    "Deciduous/Mixed", "Tundra / Non-forested")),

    Dom_species = case_when(
      # Mixed — must precede single-species detection
      str_detect(ft, "picea mariana") &
        str_detect(ft, "pinus banksiana")                              ~ "Picea mariana / Pinus banksiana",
      # Siteplot-specific overrides
      siteplot == "21_C"                                               ~ "Picea mariana",
      siteplot == "26_C"                                               ~ "Populus tremuloides / Betula neoalaskana",
      siteplot %in% c("90_B","101_B")                                  ~ "Picea mariana / Betula neoalaskana",
      siteplot == "Reid_LCC3"                                          ~ "Eriophorum vaginatum",
      siteplot == "Jl-03"                                              ~ "Peatland",
      Researcher == "Walker" &
        str_detect(ft, "non.forested|non-forested")                    ~ "Picea mariana",
      # Explicit ForestType wins
      str_detect(ft, "picea mariana|\\bpima\\b")                       ~ "Picea mariana",
      str_detect(ft, "picea glauca|\\bpigl\\b|white spruce")           ~ "Picea glauca",
      str_detect(ft, "picea abies|norwegian spruce")                   ~ "Picea abies",
      str_detect(ft, "pinus sylvestris|scots pine")                    ~ "Pinus sylvestris",
      str_detect(ft, "pinus banksiana|jack pine")                      ~ "Pinus banksiana",
      str_detect(ft, "abies balsamea|balsam fir")                      ~ "Abies balsamea",
      str_detect(ft, "populus tremuloides|\\bpotr\\b|aspen")           ~ "Populus tremuloides",
      str_detect(ft, "betula neoalaskana|\\bbene\\b|paper birch")      ~ "Betula neoalaskana",
      str_detect(ft, "\\bmixed\\b|mixed.con")                          ~ "Mixed",
      # Walker special cases
      Researcher == "Walker/Mack"                                      ~ "Picea mariana",
      Researcher == "Walker" & .sa == "AK boreal" &
        (is.na(ForestType) | ForestType == "")                        ~ "Picea mariana",
      # Tundra species (ft before eco so YKD tussock wins)
      str_detect(ft, "eriophorum")                                     ~ "Eriophorum vaginatum",
      str_detect(ft, "low deciduous|betula nana|vaccinium|rhododendron|empetrum") ~ "Low deciduous shrub",
      str_detect(tolower(Eco_Type), "moist tussock|wet tussock")       ~ "Eriophorum vaginatum",
      str_detect(eco, "tundra|peatland|non[. -]?forested")             ~ "Non-forested",
      # Eco_Type fallbacks
      str_detect(eco, "black spruce")                                  ~ "Picea mariana",
      str_detect(eco, "scots pine|young pine")                         ~ "Pinus sylvestris",
      str_detect(eco, "jack pine")                                     ~ "Pinus banksiana",
      str_detect(eco, "white spruce|spruce upland")                    ~ "Picea glauca",
      str_detect(eco, "norwegian spruce")                              ~ "Picea abies",
      str_detect(eco, "aspen")                                         ~ "Populus tremuloides",
      str_detect(eco, "birch")                                         ~ "Betula neoalaskana",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    Moisture_Class = case_when(
      tolower(Moisture_Class) %in% c("xeric")                      ~ "xeric",
      tolower(Moisture_Class) %in% c("subxeric")                   ~ "subxeric",
      tolower(Moisture_Class) %in% c("mesic-subxeric", "submesic") ~ "submesic",
      tolower(Moisture_Class) %in% c("mesic")                      ~ "mesic",
      tolower(Moisture_Class) %in% c("mesic-subhygric")            ~ "mesic-subhygric",
      tolower(Moisture_Class) %in% c("subhygric", "subhydric")     ~ "subhygric",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Moisture_Class = factor(Moisture_Class,
                            levels = c("xeric","subxeric","submesic",
                                       "mesic","mesic-subhygric","subhygric"),
                            ordered = TRUE),
    Moisture_3 = case_when(
      Moisture_Class %in% c("xeric","subxeric")            ~ "dry",
      Moisture_Class %in% c("submesic","mesic")            ~ "moist",
      Moisture_Class %in% c("mesic-subhygric","subhygric") ~ "wet",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Moisture_3 = factor(Moisture_3, levels = c("dry","moist","wet")),

    AgeClass = case_when(
      stand_age < 30             ~ "Short (<30 yr)",
      between(stand_age, 30, 70) ~ "Mid (30-70 yr)",
      stand_age > 70             ~ "Long (>70 yr)",
      TRUE                       ~ NA_character_
    ),
    AgeClass = factor(AgeClass, levels = c("Short (<30 yr)","Mid (30-70 yr)","Long (>70 yr)"))
  ) %>%
  select(-.sa, -ft, -eco)

cat("ForestGroup:\n");    print(table(site_input$ForestGroup, useNA = "ifany"))
cat("Moisture_Class:\n"); print(table(site_input$Moisture_Class, useNA = "ifany"))
cat("Dom_species unclassified:", sum(is.na(site_input$Dom_species)), "\n")

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(site_input$soilID))
cat("Site input:", nrow(site_input), "profiles,", ncol(site_input), "columns\n")
cat("MAT coverage:", sum(!is.na(site_input$MAT)), "/", nrow(site_input), "\n")
cat("Walker/Mack measured SOL pools:", sum(!is.na(site_input$residualSOL.C_WM)), "\n")
cat("New field combustion values:", sum(!is.na(site_input$SOL.C.Combusted_profile)), "\n")

write_csv(site_input, "LCC_site_input.csv")
```
